title: fleet scripts: issue-create refuses a fleet card missing area, issue type, grade or grade line; relay issue_create carries type (follow-up of #35223)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Source: topic #35205

Filing gate: owed follow-up named in the acceptance notes of PR #35223 (L1 6988050932, item C1); child of epic #35205. ⛔ Not a claim.

Grade: p3 · area:fleet · Task · blocks no running work

Blocked-by: #35223

## What to do

Under the rules #35223 lands, a fleet-filed card must carry area, issue type, grade and a grade line at filing. `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs` does not check any of them yet, and the relay's `issue_create` takes a closed parameter set with no issue type. Carry `type` through the op. Then refuse a fleet card that is missing any of the four. Record cards (seat posts, mailboxes, eval-run, qa-run) and anchor cards are exempt.

## Done when

A fleet card missing area, type, grade or the grade line is refused before any request leaves, the exemptions are pinned, and the self-test covers both.
